_note: RFC 7638 JWK Thumbprint vectors for Ed25519 keys (ADR-013 D4). Shared by the three SDK implementations, Go helpers.Thumbprint, TypeScript thumbprint (sdk/ts/src/thumbprint.ts) and Python fora_sdk.thumbprint, so all three prove byte-identical output. Each entry: a base64url-no-pad raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key and its expected base64url-no-pad thumbprint = base64url(SHA-256(canonical JWK)). Canonical JWK is {"crv":"Ed25519","kty":"OKP","x":"<base64url-nopad(pubkey)>"} with members in lexicographic order, no whitespace. The values are checked against two independent constructions of the canonical JWK: the Go implementation builds it with go-jose, and the TypeScript and Python implementations write the canonical string themselves. The last vector uses the RFC 8032 Ed25519 test-vector public key.
